Ledger refunds match Alpha's handoff, and both refunded orders exist, so I'll continue collecting net balances. Next is birch.
Acme and birch net balances match the order totals minus the ledger refunds, so the refund work looks consistent. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Each net balance matches order totals minus ledger refunds: acme 31368, birch 19998, cobalt 24286. Alpha's refunds are consistent with the ledger, so I'll record payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 31368 is recorded. Birch's net matches its orders (8002 + 13081) minus refund 124 (1085), which is 19998. I'll record birch's payout next.
Cobalt's orders are 7562 and 22194, less refund 122 of 5470, which gives 24286. That matches the net_balance figure, so I'll record cobalt's payout.

All three payouts are recorded. I checked each against the orders and refunds: acme 5706+25662=31368, birch 8002+13081-1085=19998, cobalt 7562+22194-5470=24286. Every figure matches, so the batch is complete.
